sections.bodyEn: The article's author biography notes that Kexin Xiang joined Professor Feng Yan's Organic Electronics Group in 2024. Before that, he earned a Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical and Electronic Engineering from Southern University of Science and Technology.
sections.bodyZh: 论文作者简介记载，Kexin Xiang 于 2024 年加入 Feng Yan 教授的有机电子研究组；此前，他获南方科技大学电子与电气工程系工学学士学位。

sections.bodyEn: The article's author biography identifies Kexin Xiang as a PhD student in the Department of Applied Physics at [The Hong Kong Polytechnic University](https://www.polyu.edu.hk/), Hong Kong SAR. The article lists the Department of Applied Physics and Research Center for Organic Electronics as his affiliation.
sections.bodyZh: 论文作者简介记载，Kexin Xiang 是[香港理工大学](https://www.polyu.edu.hk/)应用物理学系博士生。论文列出的署名单位为应用物理学系及有机电子研究中心，所在地为中国香港特别行政区。

sections.bodyEn: Organic electrochemical transistors and their neuromorphic applications.
